newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pacific BBA spends A$10m on pallet bin.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pacific BBA spends A$10m on pallet bin.

text.p: Diversified manufacturer Pacific BBA Ltd said on Wednesday its plastics division would invest A$10 million in a large plastic pallet bin designed for fresh produce.
Pacific BBA said the Nally Megabin, the largest bin of its kind to be made in Australia, would have a major impact on the handling, transporting and storage of virtually all horticultural products.
The 1-1/2 tonne capacity bin would be available in the latter part of 1997, and replace existing timber, paperboard and steel products, it said.
The A$10 million investment would cover new machinery and tooling for the bin, to be manufactured under licence, as well as its marketing and distribution, Pacific BBA said.
Plastics division managing director Barry Vaughan said the horticultural industry used about A$200 million worth of materials handling products each year.

The bin would provide a more hygenic, lighter and more durable alternative to traditional containers and would offer significant freight and handling savings, he said. It would also offer quicker chilling of fresh produce and less bruising, allowing greater product yield and longer shelf life.
